quote: Cross-lingual summarization is to produce a summary in a target language (e.g., English) from a document in a different source language (e.g., Chinese).

In this study, we focus on Chinese-to-English and English-to-Chinese cross-lingual summarization... Our ATS models have achieved significant improvements over the baseline TNCLS on both Zh2EnSum and En2ZhSum.
Cross-lingual summarization is to produce a summary in a target language (e.g., English) from a document in a different source language (e.g., Chinese).
outputs: cross-lingual summaries (e.g., English summary of Chinese document, Chinese summary of English document)
summaries in a target language from a source language document

quote: We evaluate all models with the standard ROUGE metric, reporting the F1 scores for ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L. All ROUGE scores are reported by the 95% confidence interval measured by the official script. Besides, we evaluate the equality of English summaries in Zh2EnSum with MoverScore which compares system output against references based on their semantics rather than surface forms.
